_comment: Canonical per-environment config for the Bronze streaming pipeline. Mirrored into bundles/bronze_pipeline.yml's target.dev.variables by convention (Databricks Asset Bundles has no built-in loader for arbitrary JSON var files) — this file is the source of truth a human or CI step reads when populating those variables, and the same values the mock data generator / event-hub simulator READMEs reference for local testing against dev. Values marked <from-terraform-output> are filled in from `terraform output` after Phase 2/3 apply, not invented here.

bronze.note: Lower than staging/prod: dev represents a small functional-testing device subset, not full fleet throughput.
